gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-geist: Stretched and spacious, Nulshock draws every letter as a steady outline. Geist keeps a quiet, level beat underneath, and nudging its size up lets the words hold as solid blocks.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-georama: Nulshock spaces its stretched letters widely, keeps capitals barely above lowercase, and draws joins no thinner than the stems. Nulshock is built to announce; Georama, with its gaping c, to be read.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-golos-text: Wide, bold and technical, Nulshock sets capitals just above lowercase, while Golos Text fills each line with generous single-stroke letters. Page after page, that widely parted s keeps the reading smooth.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-hedvig-letters-sa: Technical and stretched, Nulshock announces, like ink poured with a steady hand. Hedvig Letters Sans does the reading, its small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals, with a clear gap where c ends.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-hind-siliguri: Nulshock stretches wide with spacious tracking, capitals barely above lowercase, and an outline drawn with a steady, unshaded hand. Nulshock handles the loud statements; Hind Siliguri hums along at constant line weight.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-hind-vadodara: Technical from the first letter, Nulshock stretches wide, while Hind Vadodara stays clean, with open terminals and tall bowls. Long paragraphs glide along, every rounded form left generously open.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-huninn: Stretched wide with spacious tracking, Nulshock draws an unshaded, steady outline and keeps its capitals barely above lowercase. Huninn meets it halfway, its lowercase rising close to cap height.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-krub: Stretched and bold, Nulshock cuts every stroke to a single measure. Krub brings curves that lift off before closing the loop, plus a pronounced x-height, a lively counterpoint to the heading.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-kufam: Wide and technical, Nulshock traces a steady outline, while Kufam runs a single track width like neon tubing across the line. Reading feels bright, with generous curves and ascenders that barely announce themselves.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-lexend-deca: Nulshock stretches wide, spaced out and technical, with an unshaded outline. Lexend Deca slips underneath with small-looking capitals and big lowercase, its unswelling line giving the heading room to be loud.
